description.zh:
是否查询字幕默认模版，取值范围：
- true，查询。
- false，不查询。
> 默认模版：系统预先内置的参数集，用户可以通过AddLiveAISubtitle接口的copyFrom参数使用。
description.en:
Specifies whether to query the default caption templates. Valid values:

- true: queries the default caption templates.

- false: does not query the default caption templates.

> Default templates are built-in parameter sets. You can use them by specifying the copyFrom parameter in the AddLiveAISubtitle operation.
The page number. Valid values: 1 to 100.

description.zh: 每页模板数值。取值范围【1,100】
description.en: The number of templates on each page. Valid values: 1 to 100.
The ID of the caption template.

description.zh: 字幕模板名称，仅支持数字、大小写字母或短横线-，短横线不和位于首位。
description.en: The name of the caption template. The name can contain only digits, uppercase letters, lowercase letters, and hyphens (-). The name cannot start with a hyphen.

descriptions.zh:
本接口支持指定分页参数查询字幕模板列表信息，调用时请保证参数设置符合要求。

><notice>当前实时字幕功能处于邀测阶段，单个用户最多可添加300个字幕模板。
></notice>

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为60次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。更多信息，请参见[QPS限制](~~343507~~)。
descriptions.en:
This operation supports paging. You can specify paging parameters to query a list of caption templates. When you call this operation, ensure that the parameter settings are valid.

><notice>

The real-time captioning feature is in invitational preview. Each user can add a maximum of 300 caption templates.

></notice>

## QPS limits

The queries per second (QPS) limit for a single user is 60. If the number of calls per second exceeds the limit, throttling is triggered, which may affect your business. We recommend that you take note of the limit when you call this operation. For more information, see [QPS limits](~~343507~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live describe-live-ai-subtitle --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --subtitle-id 445409ec-7eaa-461d-8f29-4bec2eb90000 --subtitle-name sub01 --page-number 1 --page-size 100 --is-default false --region cn-hangzhou
